note: KDM2B variants (especially CxxC domain) cause developmental delay with cardiac, ocular, and renal anomalies, overlapping clinically with chromatinopathies like CHARGE syndrome while lacking classical cardinal features.

evidence.text: Individuals with KDM2B CxxC variants exhibit developmental delay, congenital heart defects in up to 78%, and common ophthalmological and urogenital anomalies.

source.title: KDM2B variants in the CxxC domain impair its DNA-binding ability and cause a distinct neurodevelopmental syndrome
source.quote: Congenital heart defects were observed in up to 78% of individuals, with additional common findings including musculoskeletal, ophthalmological, and urogenital anomalies, as well as behavioral challenges and feeding difficulties.

evidence.text: KDM2B CxxC variants cause complex structural eye defects alongside neurodevelopmental, cardiac, and renal anomalies.

source.title: Variants in the CxxC domain of the epigenetic regulator KDM2B support its role in developmental eye anomalies
source.quote: Both individuals exhibited complex structural eye defects, with neurodevelopmental, cardiac and renal anomalies variably present.
